response.title: which power station runs a crockpot the longest at a tailgate
response.answer:
For running a Crock-Pot at a tailgate, the power station with the largest usable battery capacity (Wh) will generally keep it running the longest, provided its AC inverter can handle the slow cooker's wattage.

My top picks would be large-capacity models from EcoFlow, Anker SOLIX, and Jackery. The key is to compare actual cooking hours, not just advertised battery capacity.

A typical Crock-Pot uses approximately 100–300 watts while heating, depending on its size and setting. Once hot, its heating element may cycle on and off, reducing average consumption.

For a tailgate, I'd prioritize a station that can keep food hot for 6–10 hours without needing a generator.

Longest-running power stations compared

Assuming a Crock-Pot averages 200 watts, with approximately 85% usable AC energy:
